summary: Batch 2 (9 features) backend tested end-to-end via pytest. 13/13 tests PASSED covering Participants CRUD/promote, Hospital admission/RCP/discharge, Family Wall post/react-toggle/delete + 413 guard, SMS contacts/normalize/mocked send, Care Plan Amendment generate/list/status, Adviser Brand get/put/403, Adviser Scenarios calc/persist/list/delete + means-test settings, and Adviser Global Alerts type filter. Frontend smoke could not be performed reliably because /login on the preview URL redirects to auth.emergentagent.com (Emergent google-auth shell) before the email+password form is submitted in headless Playwright — so authenticated routes were not exercisable from a fresh browser session. Manual smoke test results referenced in the review already confirmed the UI flows.

integration_issues.issue: /login navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=... before submitting credentials, blocking automated UI smoke tests. Manual login in a real browser works (per review note). Not a regression — same Emergent auth shell used by every other iteration.

action_items: If automated UI regression is required, expose a /api/test/login or token-based bypass for preview env so Playwright can set the session cookie/JWT without going through the Emergent auth shell.

Consider returning the participant name+provider directly inside the amendment letter even when provider_name is overridden (currently fallback works, just calling out the substring assertion was loose in test_generate_list_status).
critical_code_review_comments: batch2_routes.py is ~940 lines housing 8 feature areas — consider splitting per feature (participants.py, hospital.py, wall.py, sms.py, amendments.py, adviser_brand.py, adviser_scenarios.py, adviser_alerts.py) for maintainability.
`_generate_amendment_letter` uses `datetime.strftime('%-d %B %Y')` inside a hasattr guard that is always true on Linux — the fallback path is unreachable. Minor; works on Linux containers.
Asset taper clamps excess to `cap - free` only when cap>free; for non-homeowners the 100k exemption is subtracted before clamping, which is the intended order but worth a unit test for edge values.
Family Wall `_household_owner_ids` returns `[h.get('owner_id')]` — if owner_id is None, the list contains None which still works for `user.id in [...]` check but is fragile.
Hospital admission `email_service.email_tool_result` call is best-effort but blocks the request — consider asyncio.create_task() to avoid added latency on the create endpoint.
All endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection. Good.
Pydantic models, status codes (400/403/404/409/413), and audit-log wiring are all in good shape.
test_credentials: cathy@example.com / testpass123 (caregiver) + mark.adviser@example.com / AdviserPass1! (adviser) — both authenticated successfully via /api/auth/login during backend tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed Participants, hospital admissions, wall posts, amendments, brand profile, scenarios. Most are cleaned up by the test flow (wall post deleted, scenarios deleted, participants archived). A few residuals (1 hospital admission marked discharged, 1 amendment marked sent, brand profile firm_name=TEST Firm) persist but do not interfere with future runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Batch 2 is solid — re-run /app/backend/tests/test_batch2_features.py to regress. For UI smoke, you'll need to either (a) inject a session cookie programmatically before navigating to /app/* or (b) use a real browser. The Emergent auth shell on auth.emergentagent.com intercepts /login redirects in headless Playwright. Don't waste cycles trying to fight it without a token bypass.
